Dingtong Technology.why: Makes high-speed I/O connector cages (QSFP-DD / OSFP, 112G in volume production, 224G in mass production) and liquid-cooling modules that go into its connector-maker customers' modules for AI servers, switches and data centers, so AI data-center build-out drives its main growth.
Dingtong Technology.evidence: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026): the company's main customers are well-known connector makers Amphenol, Molex, TE Connectivity, AVIC Jonhon and Luxshare; its 112G high-speed products for data centers and high-performance computing are in large-scale volume production and stable supply, and 224G air-cooled products are in scaled mass production.

players.product: 112G / 224G high-speed I/O connector cages (QSFP-DD / OSFP) and connector components, plus air- and liquid-cooled cage heat-sink modules for AI servers and switches

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 2026 revenue RMB 1,029,145,854.96, up 31.17%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 183,763,471.96, up 59.24%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 174,800,278.21, up 62.73%; operating cash flow RMB 175,423,055.90, up 866.78%. Company: growth came from strong communications-connector demand, higher order volumes, new products entering volume production and a rising share of high-margin communications products, with demand for communications products used in AI servers standing out; demand for 112G I/O connectors (QSFP-DD / OSFP series) kept growing and 224G products were in batch production.

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: 112G high-speed connector products for data centers and high-performance computing are in large-scale volume production and stable supply (single-channel 112Gbps) and were the largest revenue contributor in H1; 224G air-cooled high-speed products completed validation, reached scaled mass production and entered customers' next-generation supply chain. Liquid-cooling products moved from validation and small-batch trial production to scaled batch delivery: deliveries ramped quickly in H1, especially in Q2, and the products have entered the supply chains of several mainstream AI-server and data-center customers. Company: orders are full, and liquid cooling has become its second core growth curve after high-speed connectors.
quarterly_data.figure: 112G in volume production; 224G air-cooled in mass production; liquid-cooling products in batch delivery

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: to meet surging orders for high-speed connectors and liquid-cooling products the company kept building domestic and overseas capacity and sped up its overseas plant layout. It has built 2 dedicated liquid-cooling production lines, with domestic capacity rising quickly, and new overseas capacity is being advanced. The Malaysian subsidiary had H1 revenue of RMB 9,771.14 ten-thousand and net profit of RMB 1,832.55 ten-thousand.

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report (raised-fund and construction projects): the high-speed communications connector component production project (planned raised funds RMB 388,000,000.00, 104.24% invested by June 30, 2026) is scheduled to reach ready-for-use status in December 2026. Construction in progress includes the Changsha Dingtong phase I project at RMB 198,683,868.22.
quarterly_data.figure: high-speed connector project RMB 388,000,000.00, ready December 2026

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 R&D spend RMB 71,794,297.73, up 31.60%, 6.98% of revenue, all expensed; R&D staff 672. Projects include a high-frequency high-speed connector whose parts support 224Gbps PAM4 finished optical modules (budget RMB 8,520,000.00, sample trial stage), a QSFP-Cage connector for 112Gbps and below (budget RMB 8,900,000.00, design stage), a liquid-cooled heat-sink combination module with system cooling capacity of 20 kW or more (budget RMB 8,150,000.00, small-batch trial production) and a fiber-optic connector supporting 48 or more cores per U with MPO/MTP interfaces (budget RMB 8,500,000.00, trial production).

quarterly_data.quarter: Dingtong Technology half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-05-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the BMS Gen6 battery project developed with Molex has started batch supply. The automotive connector business was under short-term pressure in H1 from industry destocking and new-energy-vehicle supply-chain adjustment, and the company kept a conservative model in domestic automotive because of rising copper and metal prices.
